about_the_game:
"Ready to face the horrors of the night?"

Story
One evening, a security officer is assigned to investigate complaints coming from an apartment building.
Neighbors report hearing strange noises and claim that something is moving inside, even though the building is supposed to be empty.
The sounds become especially disturbing at night: tapping from the walls, footsteps, faint whispers...
No one lives in the building, yet something is constantly moving within.

The complaints from the neighbors have steadily increased. No one dares to enter the building.
Based on what the neighbors have told him, our character learns that the place was abandoned after a tragic incident some time ago.
However, no one knows exactly what happened.
That’s why the officer decides to go into the apartment building to investigate the complaints and uncover the truth.

The Forgotten Apartment

"The echoes of the past still whisper through the walls..."

In an abandoned apartment, what awaits you in the dark corners?

The Forgotten Apartment offers a short yet intense experience built on forgotten memories, psychological tension, and repressed fears.
This is not a walking simulator—this is an awakening.

Features:

  • Intense Atmosphere – Every room whispers a dark secret.

  • Cleverly Designed Puzzles – Piece together the past to recover your lost memory.

  • A One-Hour Cinematic Experience – Short but unforgettable.

  • High-Quality Graphics & Sound Design – Every detail is crafted to pull you in.

The past hasn’t forgotten you.
Are you ready to face it?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains the following mature themes:

Bloody scenes and disturbing visual content

Alcohol and prescription drug bottles visible in the environment

Themes of suicide depicted both directly and indirectly

The game includes psychological horror elements and may contain content that could be triggering or distressing for some players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3100 / Intel Core i3-10100F
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 570 veya RX 6400
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 11 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5500 / Intel Core i5-11400F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1080 / AMD: Radeon RX 6600 OR RX Vega 64
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 11 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
